cells.forex: Buy or sell a pair in [[lot|lots]]; profit or loss is counted in [[pip|pips]] times [[pip-value]].
cells.stocks: Buy shares and later sell them; short selling, where allowed, has its own rules and costs.
cells.penny_stocks: Like shares, but orders can fill slowly or only in part, and the price you see may not be available in size.
cells.commodities: Usually through a futures contract or broker contract, with that product's own sizing and rules.
cells.futures: Buy or sell whole contracts; profit or loss is ticks moved × [[tick-value]] × contracts, settled daily.

caveat: Order types, sizes, fills and settlement depend on the venue and broker. Learn the exact product's rules before practising.
